Report actual changes and verification. Publication is a separate Runner stage. Do not call tools on that first input. After receiving the caller's separate answer, or on later feedback in this same session, implement the task and do not repeat the question.

Wait for this original command to finish and report its actual PR URL. Preserve an uncertain publication for original branch/PR reconciliation; never create a replacement.
